Name: obstacles.rate
"Description": "Rate at which obstacle parsing is executed using the latest available data."

Name: obstacles.limit
"Description": "Maximum number of parsed obstacles. If equal to -1
column4: no limit is imposed - this may be very computationally expensive for fine grids."

Name: obstacles.type
"Description": "Type of obstacle generated from occupied cells. Can be either {'box'} or {'cylinder'}."

Name: obstacles.inflation
"Description": "Inflaction factor used to scale the obstacles extents. May be positive or negative."

Name: occupancy.threshold
"Description": "Occupancy value above which a cell in the occupancy grid is considered an obstacle."

Name: horizon.enable
"Description": "Whether or not to use a horizon relative to AGV odometry to filter which obstacles are parsed from the grid."

Name: horizon.radius
"Description": "Radius of the horizon (centerd around the AGV odometry header reference frame) inside of which obstacle parsing is enabled. When using dynamic or adaptive horizons
column4: this parameter defines a minimum horizon length which may override the one compute dynamically."

Name: horizon.type
"Description": "Type of horizon used for obstacle filtering. Valid values are 'static'
column6: for a horizon defined by a time and a maximum traversal speed
column8: for a horizon radius that scales with vehicle speed."

Name: horizon.time
"Description": "The time span in seconds that defines the radius of the horizon assuming maximum traversal speed (+10% margin)."

Name: horizon.max_speed
"Description": "Maximum traversal speed used for horizon radius calculation for the dynamic horizon type.

Name: fov.enable
"Description": "Whether or not to use the field of view in fron of the vehicle to filter obstacles."

Name: fov.degrees
"Description": "Size of the field of view (to be intended as split into two symmetric halves with respect to the vehicle heading)."

Name: visualization.enable
column4: "Whether or not visualization markers for the obstacles and/or the search region are published. This option may have a small performance impact on platforms with limited computing power."

Name: visualization.rate
column4: "Rate at which the visualization markers are published."
